brandSubtitle: Maharashtra Rural Logistics Coordination & Optimization Platform
heroTitle: Connecting Rural Maharashtra to Smarter Logistics
heroSub: Pool shipments. Match local transport. Optimize routes. Reduce logistics costs.
tagline: From scattered village shipments to one optimized logistics network.
uspDescription: GraminLink connects rural entrepreneurs, SHGs, farmers and local transporters to pool shipments, optimize routes, share transportation costs and improve vehicle utilization.
headerTagline: Shared logistics for rural Maharashtra • Less cost, zero empty trips
featurePoolingDesc: Consolidates small 20-50 kg village packages into single high-utilization vehicle runs.
featureMatchingDesc: Matches local tempos, autos & Tata Ace drivers with verified ratings and fair freight rates.
featureRouteDesc: Intelligent multi-stop TSP routing cuts transit distances by up to 34% across Konkan and Ghats.
featureCostDesc: Fair weight-distance cost formula ensures transparent, proportional savings for every SHG.
featureTrackingDesc: Real-time vehicle GPS tracking with milestone proofs from village pickup to final Mandi delivery.
featureReturnDesc: Connects inbound farm vehicles with reverse fertilizers/raw materials so no vehicle returns empty.
heroRegionPill: Konkan & Rural Maharashtra • Simple, Affordable Logistics
heroSubquote: "From farm to mandi, share vehicles, reduce expenses."
heroDescription: Built for rural women's SHGs, small farmers, and local tempo drivers. Instead of paying full freight for small 20-50 kg packages, book space in returning empty tempos and reach city mandis at half the cost.
howItWorksTitle: Journey from Village Farm to City Mandi
howItWorksSub: No complicated process. Your goods reach safely in 4 simple stages.
warliHeading: No vehicle should run empty, no farmer should lose money.
warliDescription: In Konkan, tempos traveling from Dapoli or Mandangad to Mumbai often return completely empty. Meanwhile, local SHGs cannot afford standalone freight for 30 kg of cashews or kokum. GraminLink connects these complementary needs for mutual profit.
waHeading: Book via WhatsApp or Simple SMS
waDescription: Even with 2G or intermittent mobile network, just send a simple message: 'Dapoli to Khed 35kg cashews'. Our automated system instantly matches available vehicle, time and lowest shared fare.
waFeatureMultilingual: Supports Marathi, Hindi or English text
waFeatureDriverDetails: Instant driver phone number and pickup OTP
footerTagline: From village to market, share vehicles
footerPrototypeNote: Prototype built for the Maharashtra rural logistics challenge. All data and empty km calculations computed from local models.
footerCopyright: © 2026 GraminLink • Developed for Rural SHGs, Small Farmers & Local Transporters of Maharashtra.
